how_it_works.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about our AI system

faqs.q1: How accurate is the AI detection?
faqs.a1: Our AI model achieves 95%+ accuracy in detecting crop diseases. The model has been trained on over 50,000 images and validated by agricultural experts. However, for critical decisions, we always recommend consulting with local agricultural extension officers.
faqs.q2: What types of crops are supported?
faqs.a2: Currently, we support major crops including tomatoes, potatoes, rice, wheat, cotton, sugarcane, and various vegetables. We are continuously expanding our database to include more crop varieties.
faqs.q3: How quickly do I get results?
faqs.a3: Image analysis typically takes 2-5 seconds. The complete process from upload to receiving treatment recommendations usually takes less than 30 seconds.
faqs.q4: Can I use the app offline?
faqs.a4: Currently, an internet connection is required for image analysis as the AI processing happens on our servers. We are working on an offline mode for future releases.
faqs.q5: Is the treatment advice safe to follow?
faqs.a5: Yes, all treatment recommendations are based on established agricultural practices and reviewed by experts. However, always follow local regulations for pesticide use and consult with agricultural experts for severe infestations.
faqs.q6: How do I take the best photo for analysis?
faqs.a6: For best results: 1) Take photos in good natural light, 2) Focus on affected areas, 3) Avoid blurry images, 4) Include the full leaf, 5) Take multiple angles if possible.
